formal_statement: ∀ (n G : ℕ), (∀ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin n × Fin n → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, MvPolynomial.eval (fun p => 1 + t p) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ n) = (Nat.factorial n : ℂ)) → Module.finrank ℂ L ≤ G) → ∀ N : ℕ, PEqualNP.Gct.HasBorderDetExpression (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ (n + 1)) N → (n + 1) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ G + 2 * (n + 1) + N
plain_statement: If every linear space L of n x n complex matrices with perm(J_n + t) = n! for all t in L has dim at most G, then every border determinantal expression of perm_(n+1) has size N with (n+1)^2 + 1 <= G + 2(n+1) + N. Proof: at Sigma_(n+1) = J - (n+1)E_11, perm(Sigma + t) for t with zero first row and column is -sum_j j (n-j)! E_j(t'), so spaces through Sigma meet that subspace (codim 2n+1) in a level space; then L-gct-069.
title: Reduction of L-gct-037 to the level-space problem: a bound G on spaces where perm(J_n + t) = n! gives border dc(perm_(n+1)) >= (n+1)^2 - 2(n+1) + 1 - G
